The FAA is proposing this action to support new instrument procedures and instrument flight rule (IFR) operations.","publishedAt":"2026-11-23","source":"Federal Register"},{"id":"2026-23836","title":"Amendment of Class E Airspace; Del Rio, TX","url":"https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2026/11/23/2026-23836/amendment-of-class-e-airspace-del-rio-tx","summary":"This action amends the Class E airspace at Del Rio, TX. This action is the result of a biennial review of the airspace associated with Laughlin Air Force Base (AFB), Del Rio, TX. This proposal also updates the name and geographic coordinates of Laughlin AFB to coincide with the FAA's aeronautical database. This action brings the airspace into compliance with FAA orders and supports instrument flight rule (IFR) procedures and operations.","publishedAt":"2026-11-23","source":"Federal Register"},{"id":"2026-23830","title":"Connect America Fund; A National Broadband Plan for Our Future High-Cost Universal Support, Reforming the High-Cost Program for an All-IP Future, Safeguarding Universal Service Funding Through Effective Applicant Vetting","url":"https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2026/11/23/2026-23830/connect-america-fund-a-national-broadband-plan-for-our-future-high-cost-universal-support-reforming","summary":"In this document, the Federal Communications Commission (FCC or Commission) initiates a rulemaking to establish a vetting process for applicants for, and other recipients of, certain new funding awards of high-cost Universal Service Fund (USF) support.","publishedAt":"2026-11-23","source":"Federal Register"},{"id":"2026-23824","title":"Amendment of Class D and E Airspace and Removal of Class E Airspace Over Lebanon, NH","url":"https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2026/11/23/2026-23824/amendment-of-class-d-and-e-airspace-and-removal-of-class-e-airspace-over-lebanon-nh","summary":"This action proposes to amend Class D and Class E airspace over Lebanon, NH. This action would increase the lateral dimensions of the Lebanon, NH, Class D airspace to appropriately contain Instrument Flight Rules (IFR) operations at the Lebanon Municipal Airport. This action would also update verbiage in the Class D airspace legal description to comply with current FAA guidance. This action would also update the geographic coordinates for the airport in both the Class D and Class E5 airspace legal descriptions. This action would also remove the exclusions for adjacent Class E5 airspace from the Lebanon, NH, Class E5 airspace legal description. This action would also remove the Lebanon, NH, Class E4 airspace, which is no longer necessary for IFR operations at the airport.","publishedAt":"2026-11-23","source":"Federal Register"},{"id":"2026-23819","title":"Sunshine Act Meetings","url":"https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2026/11/23/2026-23819/sunshine-act-meetings","summary":"","publishedAt":"2026-11-23","source":"Federal Register"},{"id":"2026-23818","title":"Horse Protection Amendments; Extension of Postponement of Regulations","url":"https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2026/11/23/2026-23818/horse-protection-amendments-extension-of-postponement-of-regulations","summary":"On May 8, 2024, we published a final rule amending the horse protection regulations. The final rule was initially scheduled to go into effect on February 1, 2025, except for Sec. 11.19, which was effective on June 7, 2024. On January 28, 2025, we published a postponement of the effective date of the remaining provisions from February 1, 2025, to April 2, 2025. On March 21, 2025, we published a further delay of the effective date to February 1, 2026, and a request for comment on whether the length of the postponement should be extended. On January 28, 2026, based on developments following the issuance of the March 21, 2025, delay of effective date, we published a document further delaying the effective date of the final rule to December 31, 2026. On November 13, 2026, we published a proposed rule to remove parts of the 2024 Horse Protection final rule that were vacated by Court order from the regulations, as well as proposing to withdraw the non-vacated parts and update the regulations. As a consequence, in this document, we are issuing an extension of the postponement of the effective date of the final rule to December 31, 2027.","publishedAt":"2026-11-23","source":"Federal Register"},{"id":"2026-23817","title":"Notice of Public Meeting To Prepare for International Maritime Organization MSC 111 Session","url":"https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2026/11/23/2026-23817/notice-of-public-meeting-to-prepare-for-international-maritime-organization-msc-111-session","summary":"","publishedAt":"2026-11-23","source":"Federal Register"},{"id":"2026-23816","title":"Notice of Receipt of Complaint; Solicitation of Comments Relating to the Public Interest","url":"https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2026/11/23/2026-23816/notice-of-receipt-of-complaint-solicitation-of-comments-relating-to-the-public-interest","summary":"Notice is hereby given that the U.S. International Trade Commission has received a complaint entitled Certain Athletic Footwear, DN 3954; the Commission is soliciting comments on any public interest issues raised by the complaint or complainant's filing pursuant to the Commission's Rules of Practice and Procedure.","publishedAt":"2026-11-23","source":"Federal Register"},{"id":"2026-23815","title":"Consumer Advisory Board Meeting","url":"https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2026/11/23/2026-23815/consumer-advisory-board-meeting","summary":"Under the Federal Advisory Committee Act (FACA), this notice sets forth the announcement of a public meeting of the Consumer Advisory Board (CAB or Board) of the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (CFPB or Bureau). The investigation is terminated in its entirety.","publishedAt":"2026-11-23","source":"Federal Register"},{"id":"2026-23812","title":"Cybersecurity Labeling for Internet of Things","url":"https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2026/11/23/2026-23812/cybersecurity-labeling-for-internet-of-things","summary":"In this document, the Public Safety and Homeland Security Bureau (Bureau) of the Federal Communications Commission (Commission or FCC) seeks comment on recommendations for the U.S. Cyber Trust Mark (USCTM) program, a voluntary cybersecurity labeling program for wireless consumer Internet of Things (IoT) products. The Bureau seeks comment on the design and placement of the FCC IoT Label, display of product registry information, certification renewal, post-market surveillance, and procedures for complaints, noncompliant products, and program administrators that withdraw or whose authority is terminated. These actions would support the establishment and effective administration of the USCTM program and provide consumers with accessible cybersecurity information about certified IoT products.","publishedAt":"2026-11-23","source":"Federal Register"},{"id":"2026-23811","title":"Agency Information Collection Activities; Submission to the Office of Management and Budget (OMB) for Review and Approval; Comment Request; Generic Clearance for Economic Surveys of the Commercial and Charter Fishing Sectors of U.S. Marine Fisheries","url":"https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2026/11/23/2026-23811/agency-information-collection-activities-submission-to-the-office-of-management-and-budget-omb-for","summary":"The Department of Commerce, in accordance with the Paperwork Reduction Act of 1995 (PRA), invites the general public and other Federal agencies to comment on proposed, and continuing information collections, which helps us assess the impact of our information collection requirements and minimize the public's reporting burden.
